definition.pixelCoordinates: native crop integer pixels; evaluate centre (x+0.5,y+0.5)
definition.polygonConvention: even-odd ray crossing OR point exactly on a polygon segment; integer pixel-edge vertices
definition.candidateIntersection: fixed atlas polarity predicate AND frozen printed-field aperture
definition.ownership: unassigned; fragments are not claimed to be old whole components or full original glyphs
definition.edgeContact: any retained fragment pixel on the inner eight-neighbour aperture boundary
definition.uncertainty: glyph-edge contacts remain explicit; no font continuation or missing support inferred
